ambiguities.fragment: Routing switches ability to filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.
ambiguities.explanation: The prepositional phrase 'between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic' has ambiguous attachment. It can modify 'filter' (defining the scope of the filtering action) or modify 'switches' (defining the relationship between the two types of traffic), leading to different interpretations of the system's function.
possible_interpretations: The routing switch filters traffic that flows between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic (the filter applies to the traffic moving between these two domains).
